thread.title: Universal TV vet joining Apple - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brandy Betz
title: Universal TV vet joining Apple - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Veteran TV producer Jason Katims is leaving Universal TV for a multiyear overall deal at Apple ( AAPL +1.4% ), according to Variety .
Katims and his True Jack Productions company will stay at Universal until summer when his current deal expires and then make the move.
Katims's TV show creations include "Parenthood" and "Roswell," and he had writing/production credit on "Friday Night Lights" and "Boston Public."
Apple will reportedly launch its streaming service sometime this year.
